integrity: The proof is analytical; a finite exact and numerical verifier provides supplementary checks. Prior literature establishes the algorithms and general bounds; the sharp orientation comparison is assessed here without a claim of independent priority certification.
scientific_limitations: Exact one-column unoversampled range projection for real full-column-rank matrices with two columns and arbitrary row dimension, squared Frobenius residual, and exact arithmetic only. The result does not assert general high-dimensional performance or numerical stability.
title: A sharp orientation reversal between Gaussian and Rademacher one-probe range finders
